synth.notes:
Ring (player) + beam (arm) slide by 6 on the rail; blocks fully on the beam (any tag) are carried.
Moved rects push other blocks as a chain; A1/A2 cancel if any block or the ring would leave the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 grow/shrink the beam by 6; step-87 fix: hook/drag is tag-agnostic (todo blocks on the beam move with the tip); a blocked group means the beam moves alone.
Tags: hooked next at tip-5 with other on-beam blocks collected -> collected; collected off beam -> next; legend centres render tags.
HUD 3s = (n-1)//3, memoised by returned frame (fallback 3*threes+1). Unconfirmed: A5/A7 effects.
